card.name: Mixed word joins and "greater incidence"
card.fires_on: Fires on the word "incidence" after "a greater" in the sentence about benefit of higher doses versus adverse reactions. Also fires on odd joins such as a hyphen in a date, a word part inside a file name, or "-style".

modes.label: Greater incidence
modes.description: The word "incidence" after "possibility of a greater" in dose-benefit wording.
modes.example: The benefit of improved seizure control with higher doses should be weighed against the possibility of a greater<< incidence>> of adverse reactions.
